title: Auto Farm Auto Click Auto Sell
features: Auto Farm a program that can provide you with all the necessary game resources such as money, experience, and other items automatically, Auto Click this script is designed to perform automatic clicking on your behalf, and it surpasses other players' clicking speed. With this script, you can automate repetitive clicking tasks and save time and effort, Auto Sell is a function that automatically sells your items in the game. This function is very useful for players who want to save time and effort.
